question_summary: Field team encountered an unforeseen underground obstruction at Pour Sequence 4 and is requesting direction on whether to shift the pour layout locally while holding the rest per plan, noting a change order will be required and work is currently stopped.
proposed_solution: Shift the layout locally and hold everything else per plan.
